title: AI Cameras Help Farmers Watch Their Cows
paragraphs: Some farmers now use AI cameras. The cameras watch the cows. George McMaster has a farm in Northern Ireland. He has about 300 cows.
A camera sees each cow every day. A computer looks at the video. It can find a sick cow early.
George’s son Jack likes this. He says the cows are happier. A farmer can also use a phone app. It keeps the farm papers in one place.
